issues.on_page: Golf Fund column object lines (Personnel costs 128,337 ... Depreciation 45,000)
issues.issue: The Golf Fund cost-type lines use a function category (culture/recreation) instead of the cost type, and their original_label has '(Golf Fund)' added to the printed text. This is defensible because golf is not a utility, but it doesn't match the cost-type rule. The split amounts are printed in the fund columns and add up.

issues.on_page: Governmental funds balance sheet totals 1,559,801 = government-wide governmental total
issues.issue: The governmental funds balance sheet totals equal the government-wide governmental figures, which under the cash-basis balance-sheet rule would mean using the fund statement (fund balance by classification). The Statement of Net Position was kept because the government-wide statement includes business-type capital assets and debt. This is a judgment call.
